latest_release.name: v3.1.3
latest_release.body:
## Highlights

- Rebuild the bundled model catalog and publish it to [models.ccrdesk.top](https://models.ccrdesk.top/models.json). The catalog refreshes from the CDN at startup and hourly, with bundled and cached data available offline.
- Improve routing script token estimation, gateway restart recovery, and raw trace delivery.
- Fix Codex session affinity, protocol-specific provider aliases, and upstream streaming resets.
- Add the Y-API provider preset and bound OpenRouter catalog requests with a timeout.

## What's Changed
* fix(gateway): propagate upstream stream resets instead of crashing the core by @Louayzouaoui1 in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1858
* fix(core): send session_id header for Codex Responses prompt cache affinity by @uta-a in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1866
* fix: stop raw-trace sync from clobbering gateway response headers by @Burlesque1 in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1865
* fix(providers): bound OpenRouter provider-catalog fetches with a timeout by @pacocartones in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1756
* docs: add Parallel Search ToolHub setup example by @georgeatparallel in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1758
* fix(providers): keep custom base paths ending in /models by @ronicayu in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1834
* fix(gateway): preserve protocol selection for provider aliases by @zhi1ong in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1847
* feat(providers): add Y-API preset by @jiweiyeah in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1849

## New Contributors
* @Louayzouaoui1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1858
* @uta-a made their first contribution in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1866
* @georgeatparallel made their first contribution in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1758
* @ronicayu made their first contribution in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1834
* @zhi1ong made their first contribution in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1847
* @jiweiyeah made their first contribution in https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/pull/1849

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/compare/v3.1.2...v3.1.3
